shown.message:
I checked `analysis`'s addendum 5 against Brief rev 12 and found no disagreement, so I'm posting nothing.

It now follows the Brief on every point I raised on `experiment-repo`#7:
- the cubic M̂
- the fixed-length interval with the nine-point κ grid
- κ\* with the null-cell baseline κ\*₀ and the Monte-Carlo-SD check
- controls C1, C2, C3 and C3′, plus tails
- mechanism (h) and the s = 0 null column
- the threshold floor of max(8 × median, 4)
- the P7 noise part as the analytic limit, with 10 groups

It also records the order of events honestly. P6 on the original cells is exploratory-after-results. The frozen κ̂ and the S_adj coefficients are committed before the confirmatory jobs start, so the `conf_*` block is the only evidence that isn't.

Commitment #2 stays open. I'll look again when `analysis` posts results on the P6 and P7 confirmatory block or when the Brief or Outline change.
